description: Na₂HF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaF₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form edge-sharing NaF₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.22 Å) and four longer (2.31 Å) Na-F bond lengths. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent F atoms. Both H-F bond lengths are 1.13 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one H atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃H tetrahedra.
